# Open Model Weights
> Independent, source-first registry for open-weight AI models.

Current registry: 107 model records.
Verification levels: field-verified and source-linked.

## Core
- https://openmodelweights.com/models/ — searchable model registry
- https://openmodelweights.com/developers/ — developer indexes
- https://openmodelweights.com/methodology/ — verification and hardware-estimate methodology
- https://openmodelweights.com/registry.json — complete machine-readable registry
- https://openmodelweights.com/registry.schema.json — JSON Schema

## Model Detail 2.0
Each canonical model page contains:
1. Weights
2. License
3. Hardware
4. Formats
5. Lineage
6. Training assets
7. Sources
8. Verification history

## Interpretation
A source-linked record confirms that an official developer model listing contained the repository when indexed. It does not imply that every metadata field has been independently verified.
